decision.explanation: The question asks who is the artist of the "Classic Christmas" album. Two distinct albums share the title "Classic Christmas": one by Bradley Joseph (D1S1), released in 2008, and another by Joe McElderry (D3S1), released in 2011. Both are valid referents for the album title and are correctly attributed to their respective artists in the provided sources. Since the question does not specify which version of the album is being referenced, both answers are preserved as valid and complementary.
